title: Kad's GUI
description: A resource pack meant only to change GUI elements.
body:
# Welcome to Kad's GUI!

**The Terms of Use apply Per Version (i.e., the Terms of Use included with the resource pack version you download, you must follow that versions Terms of Use.). For a simplified idea of what you can and cannot do with this resource pack, check the Permission Summary (Under the Terms of Use), and the README.**

This resource pack requires NO MODS! That does add some complications, but i'm gonna make this a resource pack you'll love!

This resource pack changes the following textures:

------------------------------------------
GUI
------------------------------------------
- EVERY Heart Texture
- Hunger bar (Normal and when you have the hunger effect)
- The GUI for the Furnace, Crafting Table, Enchanting Table, and Chest/Ender Chest/Copper Chest/Barrel! (The Chests and Barrel all use the same GUI texture, so i created a version which works for all of them :D)

In Resource Pack version 1.1BETA2 for Minecraft version 1.20.1-, although there is no copper chest block/item, the GUI when opening a chest/barrel will still have the copper chest as part of it.

-----------------------------------


<details>
<summary>Official Extensions</summary>
  
### Official Extensions
  
Thats right, i have made an extension for Kad's GUI called... **Kad's Font**! This extension changes the font used in Minecraft to a version i personally like!

It also uses the same ToS (i.e., Terms of Use/Terms of Service), so if you have read through the Terms of use, just apply the same rules to the extension.

Its public right now! Click this to check it out!
https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/kads-font

</details>
